_extraction_context.source_title: I Make Over 2 000 A Month Selling Digital Products On Etsy 0Fb883Fa3A99
_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "I used to sell Print-on-Demand products on Etsy. Picture it: I'd design a T-shirt, someone would order it, a print company would ship it out. Sounds like a dream, right? Until I found myself sleep-deprived, buried in customer messages asking where their orders were. I realized I had built myself a full-time job — not the creative freedom I was chasing. Then I discovered digital products. No inventory. No shipping. No late-night headaches. Just a few clicks, some uploads — and passive income started to flow, even while I was watching Netflix. Last December, I made over $2,000 in net profit."
_extraction_context.subject_exact: Etsy seller reports switching from print-on-demand to digital products and earning over $2,000 in net profit in December 2024; describes digital products as passive income with no inventory or shipping
_extraction_context.metric_unit: USD net profit in one month (Etsy digital products, December 2024)
local_qualifiers: switched from print-on-demand to digital products on Etsy
